description: This file defines a view class for displaying details of a KnowledgeBase record in SuiteCRM. It extends the ViewDetail class, overrides the display method to process HTML decoding for the description field, and is associated with the 'AOK_KnowledgeBase' module.

classes.name: AOK_KnowledgeBaseViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending the ViewDetail for the 'AOK_KnowledgeBase' module, providing custom display behavior to decode HTML entities in the description.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to decode HTML in the description before rendering.

methods.name: setDecodeHTML
methods.description: Processes the description field of the bean to decode HTML entities and replace non-breaking spaces.
